mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.work_order_id, l.event_type, l.from_status, l.to_status, l.title, l.detail, l.actor_user_id, l.created_at FROM work_order_logs l INNER JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = l.work_order_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY l.created_at ASC, l.id ASC

SELECT l.id, l.work_order_id, l.event_type, l.from_status, l.to_status, l.title, l.detail, l.actor_user_id, l.created_at, u.display_name AS actor_name FROM work_order_logs l INNER JOIN work_orders w ON w.id = l.work_order_id LEFT JOIN tenant_memberships m ON m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.user_id = l.actor_user_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND l.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} ORDER BY l.created_at ASC, l.id ASC
